data.title: 八奈见杏菜 · 夏日祭的苹果糖与金鱼
data.description: 浴衣祭典，她双手分别拿着苹果糖与捞金鱼袋，站在捞水球的摊位前陷入幸福的两难；烟火亮起时抬头看天，嘴角的糖渍在火光下发亮。

data.promptProse: Anna Yanami stops at the water-balloon stall with a candy apple in one hand and a goldfish bag in the other, happily undecided about the next treat. Her blue floral yukata and yellow obi stay clear as she looks up at the fireworks. The medium view includes the basin and festival lane behind. Lantern light warms her sleeves and sugar-marked smile, while firework reflections flicker across the bag's small water surface.
